name: standards-vscode
description: Praetor CLI integration, LSP support and shared agent MCP configuration for VS Code-compatible editors

standards.lsp.enabled.description: Enable praetor-lsp language server daemon for real-time HISS invariant checking.

standards.lsp.path.description: LSP executable for the selected trusted workspace; never started in Restricted Mode.

standards.sentinel.headroomMB.description: Minimum required host RAM headroom in megabytes.

standards.cli.path.description: Absolute Praetor CLI path or PATH command; executed without a shell.

standards.verificationTimeoutSeconds.description: Timeout for explicit repository verification; expiration is reported as incomplete.

standards.mcp.enabled.description: Legacy setting; does not activate MCP or select a running model.
standards.mcp.enabled.deprecationMessage: Use Standards: Prepare Agent MCP Configuration and the shared routing configuration.

standards.mcp.path.description: Legacy setting; does not activate MCP or select a running model.
standards.mcp.path.deprecationMessage: Use Standards: Prepare Agent MCP Configuration and the shared routing configuration.

standards.modelTier.description: Legacy setting; does not activate MCP or select a running model.
standards.modelTier.deprecationMessage: Use Standards: Prepare Agent MCP Configuration and the shared routing configuration.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Read-only browsing is available; commands and subprocesses require Workspace Trust.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Praetor invokes local tools on the selected extension host filesystem.
